segments.text: And by reason of this light of nature, a meere natural man, and a reprobate may be subiect to some temptations: for example, hee may be tempted of the deuill, and of his owne corrupt flesh, to beleeue that there is no God at all. As Ouid saith of himself, Eleg. 3. Sollicitor nullos esse putare deos: I am often tempted to thinke there is no God.
